name: Vancouver Daily News
tagline: The morning brief for Metro Vancouver.
description: Vancouver Daily News is the morning brief for people who live in Metro Vancouver, ready before the commute. Every day: the council, regional and provincial decisions that change something here; getting around, from DriveBC road events and the Environment Canada forecast; the local teams; what is on; and one contested local issue with the strongest case on each side. Hosted by Mira, the Nerra Network's AI host — the stories are chosen and written by software from named local sources, and every item says where it came from.
